command: import tempfile,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,hashlib; p=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="crm-h5017-install-"); target=pathlib.Path(p.name); [shutil.copy2(n,target/n) for n in ["package.json","pnpm-lock.yaml"]]; before=hashlib.sha256((target/"pnpm-lock.yaml").read_bytes()).hexdigest(); subprocess.run(["pnpm","install","--frozen-lockfile","--ignore-scripts"],cwd=target,check=True); assert hashlib.sha256((target/"pnpm-lock.yaml").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before; print("Frozen isolated install PASS",before); p.cleanup()
